title: ICE Arrests Man Near School Bus Stop in Croton-on-Hudson, NY, Drawing Mayor's Rebuke
detail: Federal immigration agents conducted an enforcement action on Brook Street in the Village of Croton-on-Hudson, New York at approximately 7:00 a.m. on Friday, September 11, 2026, taking one man into custody near a school bus stop on a school day. Village police had no advance knowledge of the operation and did not participate in it. Mayor Brian Pugh publicly criticized ICE, saying 'Conducting an ICE operation in the immediate vicinity of a school bus stop on the morning of a school day, without any advance notification to local officials or the school district, was unnecessarily disruptive to our community,' and the village notified the New York Attorney General's office via its Federal Action Reporting Form. Another Brook Street resident was taken into ICE custody in a separate April 2026 incident and remains held at the Delaney Hall detention facility in Newark, New Jersey.

title: ICE Agents Detain and Allegedly Strike Two US Citizen Teens Filming Raid Near Alamo, TX School
detail: Two American-citizen teenagers, including 17-year-old Luis Ochoa, were detained by ICE agents on September 11, 2026 in Alamo, Texas after stopping to film an ICE enforcement action outside Santos Livas Elementary School while en route to a Marine Corps recruiting office to enlist. Viral video appeared to show an agent striking one teen multiple times and deploying pepper spray; Ochoa said his wrist was broken and the two were held for nearly eight hours before release. Family members said the teens told agents they were U.S. citizens and were told, 'I don't give a damn. Your parents can't help you now.' DHS described the teens as 'anti-ICE agitators' who 'began to harass' and later 'chased the officers down the road,' banging on an agent's window, and said agents used the minimum force necessary. The Alamo Police Department referred the matter to the DHS Office of Inspector General.
